items.title: Why Actionable Banking Is the Critical Stepping Stone to Full Autonomy
items.summary: Almost nothing is as important to someone today as their financial health. Most of us want to stay on top of what's happening with our bank accounts, like when a deposit clears so we can pay bills, if we're reaching our credit card limit, or if we have finally paid off that 30-year mortgage and can free up funds for that dream vacation or paying for our kid's college tuition. items.title: Introducing the MongoDB Vercel AI SDK Integration: Persistent Memory for AI Applications
items.summary: We are excited to announce the release of the MongoDB Vercel AI SDK integration, which provides AI applications and agents built with Vercel’s SDK with a persistent memory store in MongoDB Atlas. It's now open source and generally available on npm.

items.title: Building an Agentic Warehouse Management System—Part 3: Tools, Decisions, and Actions
items.summary: If you haven’t read the first two parts yet, I recommend starting with Part 1: Where AI Agents Add Value and Part 2: Designing and Planning the Agent. There, we introduced the WMS scenario, discussed where an AI agent can add value, and built the first stages of the implementation with Java and Spring AI.
